slides.title: Future perfect simple and continuous
slides.subtitle: Looking back from the future
goals: Use **will have + participle** for completion by a future time.
Use **will have been + -ing** for duration up to a future time.
Use time markers: *by, by the time, in…time*.

head: Form
Example
rows: By 2030, I**'ll have finished** my PhD.
In June, I**'ll have been teaching** for 15 years.

items.q: Next year we ___ here for a decade.

items.t: By the time you read this, I ___ (leave).
